Maya (Finance): vendor invoice flagged unusual spot GPU rollover charges for 2026-03-20..21. billing-bot linked CSV: https://vendor.storage/invoices/18660.csv @Prakash please triage
billing-bot: ALERT: account=redwood-cloud period=2026-03-20..21 preemptible_gpu_hours=9,420 cost=47,600usd delta=+210% vs 30d avg
Prakash (FinOps): big delta. need mapping resource_id -> project/customer before we decide credits vs internal chargebacks
Evan (Cloud Ops): initial look: many instances show metadata lifecycle=preemptible-autorestart and owner tag empty. suspect restart loop from spot-recover handler bug
Lina (GTM): check trial projects first — we can't accidentally bill trial customers for our infra errors
Prakash (FinOps): sample export (anonymized):
```
resource_id,project,customer,cost_hours,cost_usd,labels
res-3bf1,internal-demos,,120,680,owner=;lifecycle=preemptible-autorestart
res-7a6c,trial-678,trial-customer-678,360,2,040,owner=trial-owner-678;lifecycle=preemptible-autorestart
res-99d2,platform-evals,,240,1,360,owner=;lifecycle=preemptible-autorestart
```
Maya (Finance): prioritize: 1) identify customer charges 2) provisional credits for impacted customers 3) stop further autorestarts
Evan (Cloud Ops): applied temporary deny for new instances with lifecycle=preemptible-autorestart in non-prod and prod. patch out for deploy: https://git.redwood/cloud/changes/7602
billing-bot: INCIDENT created INC-2026-45 pager=eva-cloudops
Evan (Cloud Ops): can backfill owner tags for recent 48h via launch metadata. running backfill job now
Prakash (FinOps): recommend provisional credit for trial-customer-678 pending confirmation. will post full backfill mapping in ~45m
Lina (GTM): I'll contact trial-owner-678. if they confirm no activity, approve full credit
Maya (Finance): approve provisional credit up to $2,500 for confirmed customer impact. Finance will finalize after backfill results
Evan (Cloud Ops): backfill done for 48h window: 82% owner tags restored. breakdown: product-feed 42%, internal-demos 30%, unknown 28%. report: https://cloud.ops/reports/preemptible-backfill-1866002000.csv
Prakash (FinOps): suggested allocation: product-feed $18,200, internal-demos $12,900, unknown reserve $16,700. propose unknown -> central platform budget and allow 14-day claim window
Maya (Finance): platform budget covers unknown this month. finalize credit to trial-customer-678 for $2,040 (confirmed by Lina). credit_id=CRED-2026-9902
Evan (Cloud Ops): opened PRs for fix and CI lint to forbid --auto-recover on preemptible images: https://git.redwood/cloud/merge/7607 & /merge/7608. ETA fix 6h
Prakash (FinOps): follow-ups: add auto-credit policy for missing tags if customer trial cost > $1k/day; add alerting for spot lease anomalies > $10k
Maya (Finance): noted. please add decision and playbook steps to billing runbook. escalate >$10k anomalies to execs within 2 hours. closing after PR merge and invoice adj. :white_check_mark:
